_comment: Per-project vocabulary. 'exact' fixes mistakes you have actually heard in the audio, written lowercase on the left. 'vocabulary' lists correct terms; near-misses get snapped to them, and the whole list is fed to Whisper as a hint before transcription, which prevents many errors outright. Only add an entry once you have listened and are sure - a wrong guess here is worse than the original error.
_note_on_names: Prefer putting a name in 'vocabulary' over an 'exact' rule when the wrong spelling is also a real word. 'Arap' is in vocabulary, and only the unambiguous phrase 'reza arab' is corrected outright - a blanket arab -> Arap rule would corrupt any genuine use of the word.
